Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Our intended commitment is $450,000 prepaid for 12 months starting July 1, 2026.

Questions we need resolved before we finalize the PO:
- Invoice cadence: we prefer two invoices (50% on July 1, 2026; 50% on Jan 1, 2027) but need assurance on drawdown tracking and per-token consumption reports.
- Drawdown ledger: what is the expected CSV layout for weekly consumption export? Can you provide a sample?
- VAT / tax: Astra is EU-registered; please confirm whether Redwood will issue VAT invoices or if reverse-charge applies (we have attached our VAT registration).
- Bank details & remittance: will you accept net-30 for the second invoice or require upfront payment for both?

Attached: Astra_Prepay_Schedule_Q3-Q4-2026.xlsx, Astra_VAT_Registration.pdf

Looking to close by end of next week.

Best,
Lisa Mendoza
Head of Procurement, Astra Digital

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear summary. Looping in Markus (Finance) and Dylan (Ops) to confirm the specifics below. Quick answers up front:
- We can support the two-invoice split you propose (50/50).
- Redwood will publish weekly consumption extracts and a monthly reconciled ledger; Markus will share the exact CSV field names.
- For VAT: because Redwood US entity does not register VAT in EU by default, reverse-charge typically applies; we can issue an invoice that includes the required VAT fields for your reclaim. We'll confirm with Legal if any additional documentation is required.
- Payment terms: we can accept 50% upfront (due on invoice), and net-30 on the second invoice; if Procurement requires net-0 on both, we can discuss an accommodation.

Action items:
1) Markus to attach sample consumption CSV and a template ledger.
2) Dylan to confirm SSO/portal access for weekly exports and propose a shared Drive folder.
3) I will send the legal/contact for EU VAT confirmation and the DocuSign link for the agreement.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

- Monthly ledger includes running drawdown totals, invoice references, and VAT columns (taxable_amount, tax_rate, tax_amount).
- For your scenario: with $450k prepaid, our system will decrement the committed balance in real time; we can also deliver a weekly snapshot every Monday morning.
